description: Review and confirm service names, types, and initial connections

questions.question: Are all service names lowercase with hyphens (no spaces or underscores)?
Are all service types correctly identified (Lambda, RDS, API Gateway, etc.)?
questions.notes: Match service type to AWS service name

questions.question: Are there any duplicate service names?
questions.notes: Each service must have a unique name

questions.question: Are all critical connections documented?
questions.notes: Which services call which, which depend on databases, etc.

questions.question: Are there any services that should be merged or split?
questions.notes: Refine service boundaries for better modularity
